title: He held her hand through the whole night market
caption:
POV: date night means eating everything in sight
She lights up when he asks what she wants next, and soon he's feeding her grilled skewers while she clutches her bubble tea, both grinning under the lanterns.
The best dates aren't fancy - just lanterns, street food, and someone who wants to try every single stall with you.
What's the first stall you two always hit at a night market?
Follow for more tiny love stories, one bite at a time
